desc: Derive a precise necessary-and-sufficient condition for a fixed target sum \(S\), accounting for unknown entries in both arrays.
Determine which candidate values of \(S\) need to be checked and prove that no other values are necessary.
Design an \(O(N^2 \log N)\) feasibility algorithm using fixed-value multiplicities and complementary matching.
Analyze edge cases including no fixed values, unknown entries in one array, repeated values, and non-negativity.
Implement the Python stdin/stdout solution and validate it against all public samples.
